# QuotaPin 1.0.0

See your remaining Codex quota in the native account row—without opening the account menu.

This first stable command release keeps the official Codex installation unchanged, preserves the normal short-click account menu, and adds a hold gesture for QuotaPin settings. Its account-row renderer uses owner-scoped delivery and one atomic layout commit so periodic quota, clock, and local-usage refreshes cannot revive stale modules.

Install from Windows PowerShell:

```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install.ps1)))
```

The install is per-user and does not close or restart a running Codex task. This release publishes only the command-install bundle and checksum; no Setup or tray package is included.

Validated on Windows 11 x64. Windows 10 version 2004 and later remains best-effort pending a real-device report. macOS remains a developer preview pending real-hardware acceptance.
